newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Senate panel votes to keep CPMF check tax.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Senate panel votes to keep CPMF check tax.

text.p: A Brazilian Senate commission has voted in favor of an amendment to the pension reform bill which would make the so-called CPMF check tax a permanent measure, a newspaper said.

Under the amendment, government receipts from the CPMF tax would be used to finance pensions, Gazeta Mercantil said. CPMF receipts amounting to six billion reais ($5.56 billion) a year are currently being used to help fund the health system.

Supporters of the amendment said the amendment may run up against resistance in the Chamber of Deputies when the pension reform bill returns to the lower house for a second round of voting, Gazeta Mercantil said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
